blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Barangay Ginebra coach Tim Cone rued his team’s blown chance at closing out San Miguel Beer in Game 3 of the PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals on Tuesday in Dasmariñas, Cavite. The Gin Kings went down 101-98 despite overcoming a double-digit and two chances at either sending the contest to overtime with a three or win it on a four-pointer as they were forced to give the Beermen a lifeline. “We had fumblitis,” Cone said. “We missed layups, we missed a bunch of free throws, and calls didn’t seem to go our way.” READ: PBA: San Miguel avoids sweep with Game […]...
